short_bio: Australian actor who has won two Academy Awards, for The Aviator and Blue Jasmine.
biography:
Cate Blanchett was born in Melbourne and trained at the National Institute of Dramatic Art in Sydney, graduating in 1992. Her early career was on Australian stage; Elizabeth (1998) made her an international film name.

She won the Best Supporting Actress Oscar for playing Katharine Hepburn in The Aviator (2004) and Best Actress for Blue Jasmine (2013). She appeared as Galadriel in Peter Jackson’s The Lord of the Rings films from 2001, and in Tár (2022) played a conductor at the height and collapse of her career.

From 2008 to 2013 she ran the Sydney Theatre Company as co-artistic director with her husband Andrew Upton.
